concerns.text: FR-001 assumes the existence of a ‘Reddit Loneliness Longitudinal Dataset’ that provides validated UCLA Loneliness Scale scores and baseline post text for each user. No publicly‑available dataset matching this description is known; existing Reddit loneliness corpora lack self‑report survey items. This makes the core research question unanswerable, violating the methodology requirement that the plan must be able to answer the stated question.
